process_doc: Source context: This procedure describes a cardholder withdrawing cash from an automated teller machine (ATM) using a debit card and PIN. Preconditions: the cardholder has an active debit card, knows the PIN, can access the selected account, and uses an available ATM with sufficient cash to operate. Outcome: the cardholder receives the requested cash and retrieves the debit card; the Financial Institution records the withdrawal. If completion fails, the ATM provides an appropriate message without dispensing cash. Modeling judgments: the first bold actor owns each main-path task. Option steps have no bold-actor extraction, so ownership follows the grammatical actor named in each step; this is an inference. The Financial Institution lane is retained because it is an extracted actor, but it has no separate task because it appears as a counterparty in the extracted ATM steps and no explicit lane handoff is specified. The start event, end events, and exclusive gateways are inferred BPMN control-flow elements. The three option triggers are represented by entry gateways in the main path. Option A has an internal retry-limit gateway; Option B has an internal smaller-amount-or-cancel gateway. Option C has no additional conditional branch. No decomposition proposals are made, so no split rationales are applicable.
